name: Mailmodo
long_description: Mailmodo is an email marketing software that helps marketers create app-like experiences in email by adding forms, shopping cart, calendar, NPS and more widgets within the email. Our interactive emails reduce the number of steps for users, thereby increasing email conversions. You can use it to collect feedback from your users, book meetings with prospects, recover abandon carts, generate leads, and more all within emails.
one_liner: No-code email marketing platform to send forms & widgets within emails

founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio: Aquibur Rahman is a growth-focused entrepreneur and marketing leader, currently building Mailmodo, a B2B SaaS platform that helps businesses achieve 3x higher conversions through interactive, app-like widgets inside emails. As the CEO and Co-founder, he has led the company’s vision, driving product adoption and customer growth. Previously, he headed marketing at Cleartax, growing organic traffic 5x in one year, scaling CleartaxGST to 600,000+ signups, and driving multi-crore AUM in mutual funds.

founders.title: Founder/CPO
founders.founder_bio: Apurv Gupta is a seasoned technology leader and serial entrepreneur with over 13 years of experience in building and scaling B2B SaaS startups. As the Co-founder and Chief Product Officer of Mailmodo, he has led product strategy and planning, served a variety of customers across industries, and built high-performing engineering teams. Previously, he co-founded Flick2Know, where he led the development of FieldAssist, scaling it to $3M ARR without external funding.

launches.title: Mailmodo AI: Prompt-first email marketing for the AI era
launches.tagline: Do all your email marketing - from design to automation - with just prompts
launches.body:
**TL;DR:** Mailmodo AI is an end-to-end conversational AI agent that enables you to plan, create, build automations, and analyze entire email campaigns through simple prompts, turning what typically takes 4-5 days into a task of a few minutes.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4u49l4K3TUI

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94640&key=user_uploads/463208/64a5f1f5-bb74-4442-a8c9-2f15e772858d)

## **We identified a problem.**

In 2025, you can build an entire MVP in 3 days with AI tools like Lovable and Bolt. But setting up basic email flows? That still takes 2 weeks.

I've watched this happen countless times. Founders ship their product, then get stuck navigating 15 screens, learning complex automation builders, and spending hours on segmentation logic. Meanwhile, every other business tool has gone conversational.

Email marketing, however, remained stuck in 2015:  painfully manual despite being the most important channel for early-stage growth.

## **So, we built a solution**

For years, Mailmodo has been propelling emails into the future. We made them interactive through our drag-and-drop editor, turning inboxes into actionable playgrounds. But we weren't solving the real bottleneck: managing multiple workflows, juggling between tools, and wearing too many hats.

So we rebuilt email marketing from scratch around one idea: **What if you could run your entire email strategy from a single conversation?**

You describe what you want: _"Create a 5-part onboarding series for SaaS trial users."_ Mailmodo AI handles strategy, copy, design, automation, segmentation, and analysis, all from one prompt, in one place.

What used to take days now happens in minutes.

## **How It Works**

A founder types: _"Create a re-engagement campaign for users who haven't opened emails in 30 days."_

Mailmodo AI instantly:

* Segments the audience based on your data
* Generates ready-to-send email designs
* Builds the multi-email automation flow with strategic timing
* Tracks performance and suggests improvements

## **The Mission Remains**

We've always believed emails should do more, and we made it happen in 2021. Today,  they’re finally easier to create, automate, and analyze as well. 

For those building and running growth engines in 2025, email marketing shouldn't take half ya day. Thankfully, now, it won't.

That's the modern era of email. That's Mailmodo AI.\
\
**Ask**

* Please sign up on [mailmodo.com](http://mailmodo.com) and try it for free. First 500 email subscribers are free.
* We’ve launched on PH. Please help us with your love, support and feedback - https://www.producthunt.com/products/mailmodo/launches/mailmodo-ai

launches.title: Mailmodo: Email marketing platform for higher email engagement
launches.tagline: Centralize all your email marketing efforts and send interactive emails to get higher email ROI
launches.body:
I am Aquibur, founder and CEO of Mailmodo, where we are reinventing emails to help marketers get better ROI and engagement.

### The problem with today’s email marketing

Even though emails are affordable, effective, and personalized at scale, unfortunately, they're not built to encourage user conversions. 

Long user journeys from email to website/landing pages result in low conversions and limit emails as just channels for information exchange.

Moreover, even though other mediums have evolved, emails are still the same since their beginning.

### Unleashing Email 3.0

Mailmodo cuts through this long journey and allows your emails to get higher engagement and conversions using unique emails powered by interactive widgets and a centralized platform that creates, sends, automates and measures email campaigns of all kinds!

With Mailmodo you can add a live poll, calculator, or a spin-the-wheel widget to engage customers.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=64413&key=user_uploads/463208/49c88bc9-f910-4c67-8d24-884382ddbf7b)

You can even gamify your emails with a live quiz.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=64413&key=user_uploads/463208/e0a2313c-c456-4034-acbc-4eac1ece2fbe)

You can enable reservation or appointment bookings inside emails

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=64413&key=user_uploads/463208/1a70e0ff-b372-40e3-9e02-d07c24626a37)

And get reviews and responses from customers inside their inboxes.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=64413&key=user_uploads/463208/131dcaff-6d8d-4de9-8c14-b20d05810a15)

Mailmodo is a complete platform for all your email marketing needs in addition to the superior email experience and conversions that you get. Here’s a summary of what you can do with Mailmodo

* **Create any type of email much faster** than other email tools and save your team time & effort with our next-gen email editor
* Drive **higher engagement with interactive widgets** such as forms, quizzes, calculators, polls, spin the wheel, and others for use cases like surveys, feedback collection, webinar registrations, cart recovery, admission forms, etc.
* **Integrate with your existing tool stack** like Segment, Mixpanel, Hubspot, Zapier, etc. You can also use our APIs to send transactional emails or trigger based on web/platform events
* **Import contacts manually (CSV), with API, or sync contacts with easy CRM & 3rd party app** **integrations**. You can also create contact segments to send targeted emails
* **Automate email sequences with our drag-and-drop journey builder** with a variety of triggers and actions.
* Send 10k emails for free every month and **avail YC deal on all paid plans.**

Visit us at [www.mailmodo.com](http://www.mailmodo.com). If you have any questions, feel free to reach out to us at [help@mailmodo.com](mailto:help@mailmodo.com)
